verses.en: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Dani'el, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.am: በፋርስ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ በሦስተኛው ዓመት ብልጣሶር ለተባለው ለዳንኤል ነገር ተገለጠለት፤ ነገሩም እውነት ነበረ፥ እርሱም ታላቅ ጦርነት ነው፤ ነገሩንም አስተዋለ፥ በራእዩም ውስጥ ማስተዋል ተሰጠው።

verses.en: In those days I Dani'el was mourning three full weeks.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት እኔ ዳንኤል ሦስት ሳምንት ሙሉ ሳዝን ነበርሁ።

verses.en: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.am: ማለፊያ እንጀራም አልበላሁም፥ ሥጋና ጠጅም በአፌ አልገባም፥ ሦስቱም ሳምንት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ዘይት አልተቀባሁም።

verses.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
verses.am: ከመጀመሪያውም ወር በሀያ አራተኛው ቀን ጤግሮስ በተባለው በታላቁ ወንዝ አጠገብ ሳለሁ፥ ዓይኔን አነሣሁ፥

verses.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በፍታ የለበሰውን ጥሩም የአፌዝን ወርቅ በወገቡ ላይ የታጠቀውን ሰው አየሁ።

verses.en: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.am: አካሉም እንደ ቢረሌ ይመስል ነበር፥ ፊቱም እንደ መብረቅ ምስያ ነበረ፥ ዓይኖቹም እንደሚንበለበል ፋና፥ ክንዶቹና እግሮቹም እንደ ጋለ ናስ፥ የቃሉም ድምፅ እንደ ብዙ ሕዝብ ድምፅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And I Dani'el alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.am: እኔም ዳንኤል ብቻዬን ራእዩን አየሁ፥ ከእኔ ጋር የነበሩ ሰዎች ግን ራእዩን አላዩም፤ ነገር ግን ጽኑ መንቀጥቀጥ ወደቀባቸው፥ ሊሸሸጉም ሸሹ።

verses.en: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.am: እኔም ብቻዬን ቀረሁ ይህንም ታላቅ ራእይ አየሁ፤ ኃይልም አልቀረልኝም፥ ደም ግባቴም ወደ ማሸብሸብ ተለወጠብኝ፥ ኃይልም አጣሁ።

verses.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
verses.am: የቃሉንም ድምፅ ሰማሁ፤ የቃሉንም ድምፅ በሰማሁ ጊዜ ደንግጬ በምድር ላይ በግምባሬ ተደፋሁ።

verses.en: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንዲት እጅ ዳሰሰችኝ፥ በጕልበቴና በእጄም አቆመችኝ።

verses.en: And he said unto me, O Dani'el, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.am: እርሱም። እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወደ አንተ ተልኬአለሁና የምነግርህን ቃል አስተውል፥ ቀጥ ብለህም ቁም አለኝ። ይህንም ቃል ባለኝ ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጥሁ ቆምሁ።

verses.en: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Dani'el: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy YAHUAH, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ ልብህ ያስተውል ዘንድ፥ ሰውነትህም በአምላክህ ፊት ይዋረድ ዘንድ ካደረግህበት ከመጀመሪያው ቀን ጀምሮ ቃልህ ተሰምቶአል፤ እኔም ስለ ቃልህ መጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.am: የፋርስ መንግሥት አለቃ ግን ሀያ አንድ ቀን ተቋቋመኝ፤ እነሆም፥ ከዋነኞቹ አለቆች አንዱ ሚካኤል ሊረዳኝ መጣ፤ እኔም ከፋርስ ነገሥታት ጋር በዚያ ተውሁት።

verses.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
verses.am: ራእዩም ገና ለብዙ ዘመን ነውና በኋለኛው ዘመን ለሕዝብህ የሚሆነውን አስታውቅህ ዘንድ አሁን መጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.am: ይህንም ቃል በተናገረኝ ጊዜ ፊቴን ወደ ምድር አቀረቀርሁ፥ ዲዳም ሆንሁ።

verses.en: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የሰው ልጅ የሚመስል ከንፈሬን ዳሰሰኝ፤ የዚያን ጊዜም አፌን ከፍቼ ተናገርሁ በፊቴም ቆሞ የነበረውን። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ከራእዩ የተነሣ ሕመሜ መጣብኝ፥ ኃይልም አጣሁ።

verses.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
verses.am: ይህ የጌታዬ ባሪያ ከዚህ ከጌታዬ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? አሁንም ኃይል አጣሁ፥ እስትንፋስም አልቀረልኝም አልሁት።

verses.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
verses.am: ደግሞ ሰው የሚመስል ዳሰሰኝ፥ አበረታኝም።

verses.en: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.am: እርሱም። እጅግ የተወደድህ ሰው ሆይ፥ አትፍራ፤ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን፤ በርታ፥ ጽና አለኝ። በተናገረኝም ጊዜ በረታሁና። አበርትተኸኛልና ጌታዬ ይናገር አልሁ።

verses.en: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ወደ አንተ የመጣሁት ስለ ምን እንደ ሆነ፥ ታውቃለህን? አሁንም ከፋርስ አለቃ ጋር እዋጋ ዘንድ እመለሳለሁ፤ እኔም ስወጣ፥ እነሆ፤ የግሪክ አለቃ ይመጣል።

verses.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእውነት ጽሑፍ የተጻፈውን እነግርሃለሁ፤ በዚህም ነገር ከአለቃችሁ ከሚካኤል በቀር ማንም የሚያጸናኝ የለም።

verses.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.am: እኔም በሜዶናዊ በዳርዮስ መጀመሪያ ዓመት አጸናውና አበረታው ዘንድ ቆሜ ነበር።

verses.en: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
verses.am: አሁንም እውነትን አሳይሃለሁ። እነሆ፥ ሦስት ነገሥታት ደግሞ በፋርስ ይነሣሉ፤ አራተኛውም ከሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ ባለጠጋ ይሆናል፤ በባለጠግነቱም በበረታ ጊዜ በግሪክ መንግሥት ላይ ሁሉን ያስነሣል።

verses.en: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.am: ኃያልም ንጉሥ ይነሣል፥ በትልቅ አገዛዝም ይገዛል፥ እንደ ፈቃዱም ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.am: እርሱም በተነሣ ጊዜ መንግሥቱ ይሰበራል፤ እስከ አራቱ የሰማይ ነፋሳት ይከፋፈላል። ለዘሩ ግን አይከፋፈልም፥ እንደ ገዛበትም አገዛዝ አይሆንም፤ መንግሥቱ ይነቀላልና፤ ከእነዚህም ለሌሎች ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.am: የደቡብም ንጉሥ ከአለቆቹም አንዱ ይበረታሉ፤ እርሱም ይበረታበታል ይሠለጥንማል፤ ግዛቱም ታላቅ ግዛት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
verses.am: ከዘመናትም በኋላ ይጋጠማሉ፤ የደቡብም ንጉሥ ሴት ልጅ ቃል ኪዳን ለማድረግ ወደ ሰሜን ንጉሥ ትመጣለች፤ የክንድዋ ኃይል ግን አይጸናም፥ እርሱና ክንዱም አይጸናም፤ እርስዋና እርስዋን ያመጡ የወለዳትም በዚያም ዘመን ያጸናት አልፈው ይሰጣሉ።

verses.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሥርዋ ቍጥቋጥ አንዱ በስፍራው ይነሣል፤ ወደ ሠራዊቱም ይመጣል፥ ወደ ሰሜንም ንጉሥ አምባ ይገባል፥ በላያቸውም ያደርጋል፥ ያሸንፍማል።

verses.en: And shall also carry captives into Mitsrayim their elohim, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
verses.am: አማልክቶቻቸውንና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎቻቸውን ከብርና ከወርቅም የተሠሩትን የከበሩትን ዕቃዎች ወደ ግብጽ ይማርካል፤ እስከ ጥቂትም ዓመት ድረስ ከሰሜን ንጉሥ ጋር ሳይዋጋ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
verses.am: ይህም ወደ ደቡብ ንጉሥ መንግሥት ይገባል፥ ነገር ግን ወደ ገዛ ምድሩ ይመለሳል።

verses.en: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
verses.am: ልጆቹም ይዋጋሉ፤ ብዙ ሠራዊትንና ሕዝብን ይሰበስባል፤ እርሱም ይመጣል፥ ይጐርፍማል፥ ያልፍማል፤ ተመልሶም እስከ አምባው ድረስ ይዋጋል።

verses.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.am: የደቡብም ንጉሥ ይቈጣል ወጥቶም ከሰሜን ንጉሥ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ ብዙ ሕዝብንም ለሰልፍ ያቆማል፥ ሕዝቡም አልፎ በእጁ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በተወሰደ ጊዜ ልቡ ይታበያል፤ አእላፋትንም ይጥላል፥ ነገር ግን አያሸንፍም።

verses.en: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
verses.am: የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ይመለሳል፥ ከቀደመውም የበለጠ ብዙ ሕዝብ ለሰልፍ ያቆማል፤ በዘመናትና በዓመታትም ፍጻሜ ከታላቅ ሠራዊትና ከብዙ ሀብት ጋር ይመጣል።

verses.en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ብዙ ሰዎች በደቡብ ንጉሥ ላይ ይነሣሉ፤ ከሕዝብህም መካከል የዓመፅ ልጆች ራእዩን ያጸኑ ዘንድ ይነሣሉ፤ ነገር ግን ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
verses.am: የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ይመጣል፥ አፈርንም ይደለድላል፥ የተመሸገችንም ከተማ ይወስዳል፤ የደቡብም ሠራዊት የተመረጡትም ሕዝቡ አይቆሙም፤ ለመቋቋምም ኃይል የላቸውም።

verses.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
verses.am: በእርሱም ላይ የሚመጣው ግን እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፥ በፊቱም የሚቆም የለም፤ በመልካሚቱም ምድር ይቆማል፥ በእጁም ውስጥ ጥፋት ይሆናል።

verses.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
verses.am: ከመንግሥቱም ሁሉ ኃይል ጋር ይመጣ ዘንድ ፊቱን ያቀናል፥ ከእርሱም ጋር አንድነትን ያደርጋል፤ ያረክሳትም ዘንድ ሴትን ልጅ ይሰጠዋል፤ እርስዋም አትጸናም ለእርሱም አትሆንም።

verses.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ፊቱን ወደ ደሴቶች ይመልሳል፥ ብዙዎችንም ይወስዳል፤ አንድ አለቃ ግን ስድቡን ይሽራል፥ ስድቡንም በራሱ ላይ ይመልሳል።

verses.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.am: ፊቱንም ወደ ገዛ ምድሩ አምባዎች ይመልሳል፤ ተሰናክሎም ይወድቃል፥ አይገኝምም።

verses.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም በመንግሥቱ ክብር መካከል አስገባሪውን የሚያሳልፍ በስፍራው ይነሣል፤ ነገር ግን በቍጣው ሳይሆን በሰልፍም ሳይሆን በጥቂት ቀን ይሰበራል።

verses.en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.am: በእርሱም ስፍራ የተጠቃ ሰው ይነሣል የመንግሥቱንም ክብር አይሰጡትም፤ በቀስታ መጥቶ መንግሥቱን በማታለል ይገዛል።

verses.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.am: የሚጐርፍም ሠራዊት ከፊቱ ይወሰዳል፥ እርሱና የቃል ኪዳኑ አለቃ ይሰበራሉ።

verses.en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ከተወዳጀ በኋላ በተንኰል ያደርጋል፤ ከጥቂትም ሕዝብ ጋር ወጥቶ ይበረታል።

verses.en: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
verses.am: በቀስታ ከአገር ሁሉ ወደ ለመለመችው ክፍል ይገባል፤ አባቶቹና የአባቶቹ አባቶች ያላደረጉትንም ያደርጋል፤ ብዝበዛውንና ምርኮውንም ሀብቱንም በመካከላቸው ይበትናል፤ በምሽጎችም ላይ እስከ ጊዜው ድረስ አሳቡን ይፈጥራል።

verses.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
verses.am: በታላቅም ሠራዊት ሆኖ ኃይሉንና ልቡን በደቡብ ንጉሥ ላይ ያስነሣል፤ የደቡብም ንጉሥ በታላቅና በብዙ ሠራዊት ሆኖ በሰልፍ ይዋጋል፤ ነገር ግን አሳብ በእርሱ ላይ ይፈጥራሉና አይጸናም።

verses.en: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.am: መብሉንም የሚበሉ ሰዎች ይሰብሩታል፤ ሠራዊቱም ይጐርፋል፤ ብዙዎችም ተገድለው ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁለት ነገሥታት ክፋትን ያደርጉ ዘንድ በልባቸው ያስባሉ፥ በአንድ ገበታም ተቀምጠው ሐሰት ይናገራሉ፤ ነገር ግን ፍጻሜው እስከ ተወሰነው ጊዜ ነውና አይከናወንላቸውም።

verses.en: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
verses.am: ከብዙም ሀብት ጋር ወደ ምድሩ ይመለሳል፥ ልቡም በተቀደሰ ቃል ኪዳን ላይ ይሆናል፤ ፈቃዱንም ያደርጋል፥ ወደ ገዛ ምድሩም ይመለሳል።

verses.en: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
verses.am: በተወሰነውም ጊዜ ይመለሳል ወደ ደቡብም ይመጣል፤ ነገር ግን ኋለኛው እንደ ፊተኛው አይሆንም።

verses.en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.am: የኪቲም መርከቦች ይመጡበታልና ስለዚህ አዝኖ ይመለሳል፥ በቅዱሱም ቃል ኪዳን ላይ ይቈጣል፥ ፈቃዱንም ያደርጋል፤ ተመልሶም ቅዱሱን ቃል ኪዳን የተዉትን ሰዎች ይመለከታል።

verses.en: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ሠራዊቶች ይቆማሉ፥ መቅደሱንም ግንቡንም ያረክሳሉ፥ የዘወትሩንም መሥዋዕት ያስቀራሉ፥ የጥፋትንም ርኵሰት ያቆማሉ።

verses.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their YAHUAH shall be strong, and do exploits.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን የሚበድሉትንም በማታለል ያስታል፤ ነገር ግን አምላካቸውን የሚያውቁ ሕዝብ ይበረታሉ፥ ያደርጋሉም።

verses.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም መካከል ያሉ ጥበበኞች ብዙ ሰዎችን ያስተምራሉ፤ ነገር ግን በሰይፍና በእሳት ነበልባል በምርኮና በመበዝበዝ ብዙ ዘመን ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
verses.am: በወደቁም ጊዜ በጥቂት እርዳታ ይረዳሉ፤ ብዙ ሰዎችም በግብዝነት ወደ እነርሱ ተባብረው ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.en: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
verses.am: እስከ ተወሰነውም ዘመን ይሆናልና ከጥበበኞቹ አያሌዎቹ እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ይነጥሩና ይጠሩ ይነጡም ዘንድ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against YAHUAH of elohim, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
verses.am: ንጉሡም እንደ ፈቃዱ ያደርጋል፤ ራሱንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ በአማልክት ሁሉ ላይ ራሱን ታላቅ ያደርጋል፥ በአማልክትም አምላክ ላይ በትዕቢት ይናገራል፤ ቍጣም እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ይከናወንለታል፥ የተወሰነው ይደረጋልና።

verses.en: Neither shall he regard YAHUAH of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.am: የአባቶቹንም አማልክት የሴቶችንም ምኞት አይመለከትም፤ ራሱንም በሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ያደርጋልና አማልክትን ሁሉ አይመለከትም።

verses.en: But in his estate shall he honour YAHUAH of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
verses.am: በእነዚህ ፋንታ ግን የአምባዎቹን አምላክ ያከብራል፤ አባቶቹም ያላወቁትን አምላክ በወርቅና በብር በዕንቍና በከበረ ነገር ያከብረዋል።

verses.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
verses.am: በእንግዳም አምላክ እርዳታ በጽኑ አምባ ላይ ያደርጋል፤ ለሚያውቁት ክብር ያበዛላቸዋል፥ በብዙም ላይ ያስገዛቸዋል፥ ምድርንም በዋጋ ይከፍላል።

verses.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.am: በፍጻሜ ዘመንም የደቡብ ንጉሥ ከእርሱ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ የሰሜንም ንጉሥ ከሰረገሎችና ከፈረሰኞች ከብዙም መርከቦች ጋር እንደ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ይመጣበታል፤ ወደ አገሮችም ይገባል፥ ይጐርፍማል፥ ያልፍማል።

verses.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.am: ወደ መልካሚቱም ምድር ይገባል፥ ብዙ አገሮችም ይወድቃሉ፤ ነገር ግን ኤዶምያስና ሞዓብ ከአሞንም ልጆች የበለጡት ከእጁ ይድናሉ።

verses.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Mitsrayim shall not escape.
verses.am: እጁን በአገሮች ላይ ይዘረጋል፥ የግብጽም ምድር አታመልጥም።

verses.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Mitsrayim: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.am: በወርቅና በብርም መዝገብ ላይ፥ በከበረችም በግብጽ ዕቃ ሁሉ ላይ ይሠለጥናል፤ የልብያና የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ይከተሉታል።

verses.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.am: ከምሥራቅና ከሰሜን ግን ወሬ ያውከዋል፤ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ይገድል ዘንድና ፈጽሞ ያጠፋ ዘንድ በታላቅ ቍጣ ይወጣል።

verses.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.am: ንጉሣዊ ድንኳኑንም በባሕርና በከበረው በቅዱስ ተራራ መካከል ይተክላል፤ ወደ ፍጻሜው ግን ይመጣል፥ ማንም አይረዳውም።

verses.en: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ስለ ሕዝብህ ልጆች የሚቆመው ታላቁ አለቃ ሚካኤል ይነሣል፤ ሕዝብም ከሆነ ጀምሮ እስከዚያ ዘመን ድረስ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ያልሆነ የመከራ ዘመን ይሆናል፤ በዚያም ዘመን በመጽሐፉ ተጽፎ የተገኘው ሕዝብህ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ ይድናል።

verses.en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.am: በምድርም ትቢያ ውስጥ ካንቀላፉቱ ብዙዎች ይነቃሉ፤ እኵሌቶቹ ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት፥ እኵሌቶቹም ወደ እፍረትና ወደ ዘላለም ጕስቍልና።

verses.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.am: ጥበበኞቹም እንደ ሰማይ ፀዳል፥ ብዙ ሰዎችንም ወደ ጽድቅ የሚመልሱ እንደ ከዋክብት ለዘላለም ይደምቃሉ።

verses.en: But thou, O Dani'el, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.am: ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ ቃሉን ዝጋ፥ መጽሐፉንም አትም፤ ብዙ ሰዎች ይመረምራሉ፥ እውቀትም ይበዛል።

verses.en: Then I Dani'el looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.am: እኔም ዳንኤል አየሁ፤ እነሆም፥ ሁለት ሌሎች ቆመው ነበር፥ አንዱ በዚህ በወንዙ ዳር፥ ሌላውም በዚያ በወንዙ ዳር።

verses.en: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
verses.am: አንዱም ከወንዙ ውኃ በላይ የነበረውን በፍታም የለበሰውን። የዚህ ድንቅ ፍጻሜ እስከ መቼ ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.am: ከወንዙም ውኃ በላይ የነበረው በፍታም የለበሰው ሰው ቀኝና ግራ እጁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሥቶ። ለዘመንና ለዘመናት ለዘመንም እኵሌታ ነው፤ የተቀደሰውም ሕዝብ ኃይል መበተን በተጨረሰ ጊዜ ይህ ሁሉ ይፈጸማል ብሎ ለዘላለም ሕያው ሆኖ በሚኖረው ሲምል ሰማሁ።

verses.en: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Master, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.am: ሰማሁም ነገር ግን አላስተዋልሁም፤ የዚያን ጊዜም። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ የዚህ ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ምንድር ነው? አልሁ።

verses.en: And he said, Go thy way, Dani'el: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ። ዳንኤል ሆይ፥ ቃሉ እስከ ፍጻሜ ዘመን ድረስ የተዘጋና የታተመ ነውና ሂድ፤

verses.en: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ሰውነታቸውን ያጠራሉ ያነጡማል ይነጥሩማል፤ ክፉዎች ግን ክፋትን ያደርጋሉ፤ ክፉዎችም ሁሉ አያስተውሉም፥ ጥበበኞች ግን ያስተውላሉ።

verses.en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.am: የዘወትሩም መሥዋዕት ከቀረ ጀምሮ፥ የጥፋትም ርኵሰት ከቆመ ጀምሮ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ዘጠና ቀን ይሆናል።

verses.en: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.am: የሚታገሥ፥ እስከ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት ቀንም የሚደርስ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
verses.am: አንተ ግን እስከ ፍጻሜው ድረስ ሂድ፤ አንተም ታርፋለህ፥ በቀኑም መጨረሻ በዕጣ ክፍልህ ትቆማለህ።
